# Type Alias: Hook

> **Hook** = (`services`) => `Promise`\<[`TransitionResult`](TransitionResult.md)\>

A registered conversation hook. Export one default async function with this signature.

## Parameters

### services

[`HookServices`](../interfaces/HookServices.md)

## Returns

`Promise`\<[`TransitionResult`](TransitionResult.md)\>

## Remarks

Hooks run before the conversation transition. Service writes are separate
commits: make effects retry-safe because a later failure does not roll back earlier writes.
No imports, network, timers, filesystem or whole-world access are available.
